sys.path.append('storage')
from telos import aos_manager

TICK_TO_LOG = 192

aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=TICK_TO_LOG, type="goto", target="archive", metadata={})
aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=TICK_TO_LOG, type="read", target="Archive #41", metadata={})
aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=TICK_TO_LOG, type="submit", target="Log Tick 191 Actions", metadata={"status": "failed", "reason": "Command not recognized"})
